exposure: postnatal corticosteroid use for chronic lung disease (PNCSCLD)
cohort: Preterm infants less than 29+0 weeks' gestation born between January 1, 2007, and December 31, 2017, who were alive at discharge and without any major congenital anomalies.
finding: Postnatal corticosteroid use for chronic lung disease (PNCSCLD) was associated with a greater incidence of moderate to severe functional disability (MSFD) in preterm infants.
